tools.name: generate_funnel
tools.description: Generate a hosted Amazon affiliate landing page from a US amazon.com product URL the user gave you. One call takes ~4 minutes and costs real money, with no undo and no refund, so call it only for a link the user actually supplied. Never build a URL from an ASIN you remember, and never submit an exam

tools.description: Check the status of a funnel being generated.

tools.description: List available style axes for funnel generation.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "generate_funnel" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Generate an Amazon affiliate sales funnel from a product URL. Returns a hosted landing page URL. No account needed." → after: "Generate a hosted Amazon affiliate landing page from a US amazon.com product URL the user gave you. One call takes ~4 minutes and costs real money, with no undo and no refund, so call it only for a link the user actually supplied. Never build a URL from an ASIN you remember, and never submit an exam"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
